verses.en: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
verses.pt: Cantarei a benignidade e o juízo; a ti, Senhor, cantarei.
verses.en_web: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Yahweh, I will sing praises.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David.> I will make a song of mercy and righteousness; to you, O Lord, will I make melody.

verses.en: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.pt: Portar-me-ei sabiamente no caminho reto. Oh, quando virás ter comigo? Andarei em minha casa com integridade de coração.
verses.en_web: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.
verses.en_bbe: I will do wisely in the way of righteousness: O when will you come to me? I will be walking in my house with a true heart.

verses.en: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
verses.pt: Não porei coisa torpe diante dos meus olhos; aborreço as ações daqueles que se desviam; isso não se apagará a mim.
verses.en_web: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.
verses.en_bbe: I will not put any evil thing before my eyes; I am against all turning to one side; I will not have it near me.

verses.en: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
verses.pt: Longe de mim estará o coração perverso; não conhecerei o mal.
verses.en_web: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.
verses.en_bbe: The false heart I will send away from me: I will not have an evil-doer for a friend.

verses.en: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
verses.pt: Aquele que difama o seu próximo às escondidas, eu o destruirei; aquele que tem olhar altivo e coração soberbo, não o tolerarei.
verses.en_web: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is haughty and conceited.
verses.en_bbe: I will put to death anyone who says evil of his neighbour secretly; the man with a high look and a heart of pride is disgusting to me.

verses.en: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.pt: Os meus olhos estão sobre os fiéis da terra, para que habitem comigo; o que anda no caminho perfeito, esse me servirá.
verses.en_web: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.
verses.en_bbe: My eyes will be on those of good faith in the land, so that they may be living in my house; he who is walking in the right way will be my servant.

verses.en: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.pt: O que usa de fraude não habitará em minha casa; o que profere mentiras não estará firme perante os meus olhos.
verses.en_web: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.
verses.en_bbe: The worker of deceit will not come into my house; the false man will have no place before my eyes.

verses.en: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
verses.pt: De manhã em manhã destruirei todos os ímpios da terra, para desarraigar da cidade do Senhor todos os que praticam a iniqüidade.
verses.en_web: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land; to cut off all the workers of iniquity from Yahweh’s city.
verses.en_bbe: Morning by morning will I put to death all the sinners in the land, so that all evil-doers may be cut off from Jerusalem.
